accuracyFlags: 'Level 2 and above bring closures of tracks and, at Tongariro, sections of the Alpine Crossing' - closures follow DOC risk assessment, not automatically VAL 2; the Crossing normally stays open at VAL 1 and can be open at 2. Reword.

FAQ: 'Level 0 to 2 covers everything from dormant to minor unrest' - GeoNet: 0 no unrest, 1 minor unrest, 2 moderate to heightened unrest, 3 minor eruption. Level 2 is not 'minor unrest'; fix definitions and cite GeoNet VAL table.
'Level 1 ... is common at Ruapehu and White Island' - White Island/Whakaari tours ended after the 2019 eruption; update and avoid implying visits.
Alert levels and Tongariro closure status are time-sensitive; page lacks a dated 'as of' with live GeoNet/DOC link at the top.
